newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Forrestania up on nickel discovery.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Forrestania up on nickel discovery.

text.p: Shares in gold and base metals miner Forrestania Gold NL shares rose over seven percent in early trade on Thursday on its nickel find at its Roundtop joint venture near the Maggie Hays nickel find in Western Australia.
At 10.35 a.m. (2335 GMT), Forrestania shares were 15 cents or 7.54 percent higher at A$2.14 with over 60,000 shares traded.
"I think it must be on the back of that (nickel find)," one Perth-based broker said.
Forrestania announced after the market close on Wednesday that an intersection of 6.7 metres grading 3.61 percent nickel from a depth of 193.3 metres was recorded.
The 50/50 Lake Johnston joint venture of Forrestania and Gencor Ltd has 75 percent of Roundtop and Capricorn Resources Australia NL has 25 percent.
Capricorn shares were three cents or 26.09 percent up at 14.5 cents at 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT).
